name: Web UI in-progress animation + handoff resilience
description:
Two improvements surfaced during heca testing.

**(A) Web UI animation fix** — the `ap-in-progress` animated background glow + pinging dot (orange border/bg pulse) is currently gated on the DERIVED phase/feature status (`phase.status === "in-progress"`). Because derive logic returns `in-progress` whenever ANY task is `done` or `in-progress`, a phase that is partially done but currently idle (e.g. 13 done, 0 actively in-progress) gets the full pulse animation — misleading, since nothing is actively being worked on. Fix: gate the animation on `hasActiveTask` (`tasks.some(t => t.status === "in-progress")`), and give the derived-`in-progress`-but-idle state only a subtle static border/bg (no animation). Files: `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx` (feature row ~L99, phase row ~L201). Task rows already correct (gated on `task.status`).

**(B) Handoff resilience** — the current handoff lifecycle deletes the handoff content (`phase.handoff = ""`) the moment the agent reads it on recap (`handoff clear`). If a restart/crash/extension-update happens between read and actual resume, the handoff is lost and the restarted agent cannot resume (user hit exactly this: agent cleared handoff → extension update → restart → no handoff → agent lost). Redesign:
- Keep `phase.handoff` intact across reads; track read state with a new `phase.handoffReadAt` timestamp so recap doesn't re-prompt every turn.
- Auto-clear the handoff only when a task IN THE PHASE moves to `in-progress` (work actually started) — not on read. Keep the existing auto-clear on phase `done`.
- Archive cleared handoffs to a subfolder `.planner/handoff-archive/<phaseId>-<ISO>.md` (gitignored), keeping the last 5 per phase. Phase stores light metadata (`handoffHistory: [{ file, clearedAt, reason }]`, capped 5) so tools/UI can list + recover without scanning.
- Keep the manual `handoff clear` tool for explicit cleanup (archives too).
- Update recap/protocol text so agents do NOT auto-clear on read; they set `handoffReadAt` instead.
Files: `packages/plan-core/src/schema.ts` (PhaseSchema + new HandoffHistoryEntrySchema), `packages/plan-core/src/plan-store.ts` (clearPhaseHandoff → archive+clear, auto-clear on task-start, rotation, gitignore template), `packages/pi-adapter/src/index.ts` + `packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts` (handoff tools + recap protocol text), `packages/plan-web-ui/src/components/dashboard/work-tree-rows.tsx` (animation fix). Behaviors to preserve: existing `listHandoffs` API, auto-clear-on-done, handoffUpdatedAt audit trail.

Stack: React + TypeScript (web-ui), Hono (server), Zod (schema), Pi adapter (TypeScript). Branch: `next` (deploy @next for testing before merge to develop).
